set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Fast PR gates cover FGW/FUGW and a formerly slow family with quality checks.
- Nightly gates cover partial, semi-relaxed, sampled, UCOOT, threads, and larger sizes.
- Regression criteria are statistically defensible.
- Artifacts retain raw data, environment, and crossover reports.
- Threshold changes require reviewed evidence.
- Infrastructure and solver failures are distinguishable.
set.title: Install flagship correctness-plus-performance CI gates
